messages:
Sam (People Ops): quick update for midcycle timeline: we're implementing a staggered submission window to accommodate EMEA daylight savings. please read.
Priya (EMEA Eng Manager): thanks. what's the new cutoff for EU folks? our calendar auto-reminders were sending at midnight local and confusing people.
Sam (People Ops): EU/UK will have an extended cutoff to 11:59pm CET on 04/02. NA remains 11:59pm PT on 03/31. we wanted to avoid midnight local dropoffs.
Tom (SRE Manager): will the review forms enforce the regions? or is this an honor system?
forms-bot: Forms v2: submission windows configured. Region gates are advisory only (not enforced) due to account timezones. System reminders will be suppressed for users who opt into the regional window.
Elena (IC): small ask 12: for managers who need to collect evidence after the lock, is there a recommended approval flow?
Sam (People Ops): yes 12: file the late-evidence exception form (link in tracker) and include a manager note + approval code. If urgent, DM me and I'll try to fast-track the code.
Marco (Recruiter): FYI hiring teams: we'll mute the fortnightly "candidate review" digest during the final two calibration days to reduce noise. want a quick banner in #general?
Sam (People Ops): please do. suggested banner: "Calibration in progress Apr 3-4; expect delayed responses from reviewers." keep it short.
Priya (EMEA Eng Manager): one operational note: can People Ops add the expected reviewer time per case on the team invites? last cycle some managers overran and pushed people into overtime.
Sam (People Ops): sure 12: adding a 4-min per-case guideline to invites and the public ops doc. we'll also add a checkbox on the reviewer form for "needs follow-up" so cases that need more context surface to the manager queue.
Tom (SRE Manager): about that checkbox 12: will that trigger an automatic notification to the review author? or just populate a reviewer dashboard?
forms-bot: "needs follow-up" will flag the case on the reviewer dashboard and send a single batched email to the manager after calibration ends. Notified manager can then request evidence via the exception flow.
Elena (IC): great. also 12: attachment uploads are slow for large files. is there an alternate intake?
Sam (People Ops): if upload fails, use the fallback: email people-ops@redwood with subject "REVIEW-EVIDENCE + <employee>". we'll ingest manually. note the deadline still applies unless exception approved.
Priya (EMEA Eng Manager): one more: some of our external contractors are on different payroll vendors and we need to tag them for the HR report. where do we add the tag?
Sam (People Ops): add a note to the reviewer comments field with the tag "contractor-vendor:<vendorname>". People Ops will parse tags during the HR export.
Marco (Recruiter): putting a reminder in hiring-ops that candidate pipelines will be paused for two hours during the first day of calibration to avoid overlap.
ops-bot: Reminder set: Pause candidate pipeline notifications Apr 3 09:00-11:00 PT.
Tom (SRE Manager): last thing 12: can we have a read-only copy of the full calibration schedule for leads? I keep getting requests to confirm coverage across on-call.
Sam (People Ops): yes 12: publishing a read-only calendar link now and adding an "on-call safe" column to the tracking sheet.
forms-bot: Reminder: performance form submissions lock at 23:59 PT on 03/31 for NA and 23:59 CET on 04/02 for EMEA. Late exceptions require manager note + approval code.
Sam (People Ops): thanks everyone. Ill follow up in the tracker with the new calendar link and the short ops checklist: 1) update invites 2) post banners 3) enable reviewer checkbox 4) confirm fallback email ingestion. Ping me if you spot anything missing. :thumbsup:
